comment: Shared golden for the home-path contract between internal/home (Go) and gui/electron/home.ts (TypeScript). Each row pins what both sides must agree on: which platform value selects which branch, the state-root suffix per channel, and that FLT_HOME overrides everything. base names the source the row's fallback reads (LOCALAPPDATA / HOME / XDG_STATE_HOME / FLT_HOME); each side resolves that source natively and asserts its result ends with the suffix. The Go test asserts the rows matching its GOOS; the TS test asserts every row with process.platform stubbed.
